notes: Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) has the deepest guide in this batch, at completion stage 1. It has 20 written subpages (about 97,000 characters), including 12 walkthrough chapter pages from Prologue to the final battle, plus Abilities, Materials, Recipes and Zonai Devices. Its Shrines, Side Quests, Memories, Armor, Weapons and Key Items pages are listed but not written. Chapter order follows the walkthrough contents. Titles were reworded to keep story spoilers out, and no text was copied. Adapting it later is allowed under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution and share-alike. zelda.fandom.com also answers the API, with about 378 linked pages. RAWG lists it under the slug the-legend-of-zelda-breath-of-the-wild-sequel.
